invariants.rationale: The returned iterator should not be null as it is produced via Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
The recordMap is provided to the HoodieCreateHandle constructor, which likely expects a non-null map.
If the iterator has a next element, it should be a non-null List as per Collections.singletonList(...) usage.
partitionPath is passed into HoodieCreateHandle and is likely required to be non-null.
If the iterator has elements, they are single List<WriteStatus> instances as per the singletonList wrapping, and lists always have non-negative size.
